<b>Savage Beastfly</b> is a [[Grand Hunt Wishes|Grand Hunt Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> started from the Wishwall in [[Bellhart]].

== Wish ==
[[File:Horn Fragment.png|link=Horn Fragment|left|thumb|100x100px]]

To complete the Wish, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must locate and defeat the [[Savage Beastfly]], which is located in [[Far Fields]], in the arena where [[Fourth Chorus]] was previously defeated. Its location can be tracked by interacting with the objects it leaves behind. After slaying the Savage Beastly, Hornet can break off the [[Horn Fragment]] from its corpse.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = File:Mapshot SS Bellhart Wishwall.png!Location of Wishwall in Bellhart
| Image2 = File:Mapshot SS Savage Beastfly 02.png!Location of Savage Beastfly in Far Fields
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Mask Shard (Silksong).png|link=Mask Shard (Silksong)|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After defeating Savage Beastfly and turning in the [[Horn Fragment]] to Bellhart's Wishwall, Hornet is rewarded with a [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|Mask Shard]].
